pictures.author: Benoît Prieur
pictures.observations: Full fish-shaped swept canopy over the main bowl, plaza and theater; pale outer skirt, gridded translucent-looking inner panels, open perimeter supports, independent lake and neighboring buildings. Viewed only; no pixels copied.

pictures.author: Redspork02
pictures.observations: Open east facade beneath pale curved fascia; massive light columns, branched roof supports and exposed roof trusses. Night blue lighting, lettering, crowd and vegetation are not copied as fixed materials.

pictures.author: PontiacAurora
pictures.observations: Open multi-level concourse, concrete retaining levels, steel columns/cross braces, attached escalator/stair geometry and sunken field glimpsed beyond. Exact equipment inventory simplified.

pictures.author: Thank You (21 Millions+) views
pictures.observations: Blue-gray seating tiers with pale radial aisles, stacked suite/ribbon bands, supported neutral football field and goalposts. Exact seat counts, changing team logos and painted numbers are excluded.

pictures.observations: Covered full bowl and enormous hollow double-sided oval suspended screen; thin hangers connect to gridded canopy. Construction-stage field equipment is excluded; later picture supplies neutral football configuration.
